title: Generate All Subsets
statement:
Given an array of distinct integers, generate all possible subsets (the power set).

Print each subset on its own line with elements space-separated in sorted order. Print subsets in lexicographic order. Print the empty subset as an empty line.
constraints:
1 <= N <= 10
-10 <= A[i] <= 10
All elements are distinct.
inputFormat:
The first line contains N.
The second line contains N space-separated integers.
outputFormat: All 2^N subsets, one per line, elements sorted. Print subsets in lexicographic order (empty set first).

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
arr.sort()
